comments.note: In _derive_repo_name(), the empty-name guard (name.lower() if name else fallback) is technically unnecessary because Path.name on a root component like '/' returns '' only in degenerate cases. The guard is harmless and defensive — no change recommended.

The second inline derivation in the run-queue block used `plan_dir.parents[3].name or None` (converting empty string to None) whereas _derive_ledger_log_dir used `or 'unknown'`. The new _derive_repo_name() call uses `_derive_repo_name(plan_dir, '') or None` which preserves the None-on-empty semantics of the original code. These two call sites intentionally use different fallback values — a comment in cli.py would help future readers understand why.
No observations beyond the above — cli.py is well-structured, consistently documented, and the refactor is clean.
